title: Closing the interview
summary: Russell winds up; Lee says he'd love to play again.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: Lee, we don't want to bother you with any more questions. I think that covers your life pretty well there.
I'd love to live to play again, Bill. Well, I think you can. I know, Bill. I'd love to see you sitting up here.
I don't think I'll ever play no more. Your voice is good and strong, as strong as ever, I think.
